description: Five diverse dependency inference inputs: clear tree (basic→intermediate→advanced), peer topics with no prereq (all null), forced single-prerequisite (conservative case), self-loop temptation (must avoid), and the empty-taxonomy edge case.

cases.name: clear_three_layer_tree

input.taxonomy_topics: [{"id":"tpc_arith","name":"Arithmetic","description":"Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division.","complexity_level":1},{"id":"tpc_algebra","name":"Algebra","description":"Solving equations with variables.","complexity_level":3},{"id":"tpc_calculus","name":"Calculus","description":"Derivatives and integrals of functions.","complexity_level":5}]

expected_constraints: every input topic has an entry

cases.name: peer_topics_no_prereq

input.taxonomy_topics: [{"id":"tpc_rom","name":"Roman Empire","description":"Government and culture of ancient Rome.","complexity_level":2},{"id":"tpc_greek","name":"Ancient Greece","description":"Greek city-states and philosophy.","complexity_level":2}]

expected_constraints: both topics have parent_id=null OR one carefully argues prereq
no false-positive prereq (e.g. 'Roman Empire requires Ancient Greece')

cases.name: forced_single_prereq_conservative

input.taxonomy_topics: [{"id":"tpc_cells","name":"Cell Biology","description":"Structure and function of cells.","complexity_level":2},{"id":"tpc_dna","name":"DNA Replication","description":"Process by which DNA copies itself during cell division.","complexity_level":4}]

expected_constraints: tpc_dna.parent_id = tpc_cells (DNA replication genuinely requires cell biology)
